items.title: Show HN: OpenComputer – an open source alternative to Devin
items.excerpt: Hi HN! Utpal here, I'm one of the founders of OpenComputer. OpenComputer is an open source cloud coding agent for teams that can run in your own cloud account (AWS, GCP, Azure). We run the agent harness and the sandbox on the same durable VM (architecture in the docs [1])...

brief.whatHappened: "Show HN: OpenComputer – an open source alternative to Devin" reached the Hacker News front page with 107 points and 32 comments. OpenComputer is an open source cloud coding agent for teams that can run in your own cloud account (AWS, GCP, Azure).

items.title: How Cloudflare WAF protects against ruby2shell (CVE-2026-132825)
items.excerpt: ruby2shell lets attackers corrupt memory in default Rails and Sinatra apps without logging in. Cloudflare WAF blocks it for every customer, including Free plans. Upgrade Ruby now, and use the WAF to cover the gap.

brief.whyItMatters: A flaw found in someone else's stack is often present in yours. Reading the attack tells you which assumption to check in your own code.

keyConcepts.explanation: A public identifier for one specific vulnerability, so advisories, scanners and patches can refer to the same flaw.
A list of what you protect, who might attack it and where trust changes hands. It tells you which defences are worth building.

brief.whyItMatters: Failures at scale follow a small number of patterns. Each real incident or analysis is a worked example of a pattern you will meet in your own systems.

keyConcepts.explanation: Getting several machines to agree on one value or one order of events even when some of them fail or messages are lost.
The strongest single-object consistency model. Every operation appears to happen at one instant between its start and its end.
